notes_for_editor: Only the tnlandforms.us list and Wikipedia's Gibson article give facts. The list tags the tower gfc-621, and the page does not say what gfc means; other Georgia records use GFC as the register name. The record's registers value GFC US 621 keeps a US part the list does not show, but other Georgia GFC records use the same form (for example us-ga-air-line, US 920), so no correction is proposed. No NHLR, FFLOS, Forest Lookouts or photo source in the cache matched. Two web searches found no history. Access and status are unknown. Needs a records check before a longer story.
